geometry.rgb_resize: PIL direct bilinear, no aspect-ratio preservation
geometry.raw_normalization: none; no added LN or L2

learning.exact_replay_denominator: recompute differentiably from each replay pre-step state; retain its derivative
learning.first_order_rule: detach entire increment partial_phi(loss)/d, not only numerator
learning.actual_inter_record_graph: detach actual fast state after every update
learning.meta_query_state: same phi_after_support4 for all four query losses
learning.meta_query_reduction: unweighted arithmetic mean of four half-squared losses
learning.theta_within_label_block: constant through actual eight fast updates and replay until slow commit
learning.after_slow_commit: retain actual phi_after_all8; no rebase or reset
learning.zero_residual_geometry_parity_scope: full bank non-noop; decisions outside forced warmup, or nonnegative prior during warmup
learning.no_fast_adaptation_control: zero-residual geometry admission on its own trajectory outside learned warmup; not globally identical to GEOMETRIC because warmup may change banks; no trainable slow-path claim

numerics.scalar_dtype: float64 for risks-as-scalars, c, gamma, y, log1p, d accumulation, final p, loss and step arithmetic
numerics.readout_scale_feature: log1p(c) cast to float32 for neural readout; use that same cast value in a/d
numerics.scalar_prior: canonical FP64 numerator shared by GEOMETRIC and learned prior; do not recover sign from rounded stats[-1]
numerics.residual_dot: promote fast readout weights and already-FP32 neural input to float64 before multiplication and reduction; use that same input in d
numerics.exact_derivative_scope: declared autograd/derivative-bridge semantics including differentiable parameter casts, not derivative of discrete machine rounding
numerics.parameter_step_cast: compute step in float64 then cast next parameter to float32 differentiably
numerics.nonfinite_policy: rollback whole image event, export failure and stop trial
numerics.stability_claim: no general contraction or bounded-fast-step theorem; first zero-head same-context step only

store_replay: eight-label block prefix up to7 records
state.load_policy: validate entire temporary owner topology/dtypes/counts/RNG/finite values before commit
state.score_policy: read-only scientific state; no controller, pending resolution or learning
